name: stream-machine
description: Hosted Twitch tools plus OBS and Stream Deck controls for your desktop.

interface.longDescription: Spend more time streaming and less time on manual setup. Sign in to the hosted Stream Machine server with Twitch, then open the Stream Machine menu to see a channel snapshot, work with your clips, and preview a stream title before you approve it. On the desktop app, the local stream-machine-desktop server adds 3 OBS tools and 4 USB Stream Deck tools. OBS and Stream Deck control need the ChatGPT desktop app. On ChatGPT web and mobile, only the hosted Twitch tools are available.
defaultPrompt: Connect my Twitch account and open the Stream Machine menu.
Show my channel snapshot and recent clips.
Check OBS and my Stream Deck, then show an OBS alert.
